items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Nick Damayo only in the interviewer's question and subsequent narration about Juan Tizol; the interviewee (Juan Tizol) does not speak or provide any personal interaction details.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think he was a little jealous of Juan. Because, see, Louie asked Juan to be manager, and Juan told him he didn't want that -- because you know, you make a lot of enemies being the manager, and Juan said, 'I don't want to be the manager of no band.' Juan used to start Duke Ellington's band for him all the time for him, you know, rehearsing, and he did the same thing for Harry James, and you know, you make a lot of enemies like that.
